connector.name: TrustAgent - counterparty verification
connector.registryDescription: Is this address safe to pay? OFAC sanctions, ERC-8004 reputation, contract analysis.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package trustagent-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.trust-agent, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: TRUSTAGENT_URL
env.description: Service to query. Defaults to the hosted deployment.

env.name: TRUSTAGENT_WALLET_KEY
env.description: Private key of a funded Base wallet. Enables the four paid tools, which settle per call in USDC over x402. Omit to run the free tools only — they need no wallet. Requires the optional peer dependency x402-fetch.

env.name: TRUSTAGENT_MAX_PER_CALL_USD
env.description: Refuse any single paid call above this amount.

env.name: TRUSTAGENT_MAX_SESSION_USD
env.description: Total spend ceiling across all paid calls in one session. A model looping on a retry is the realistic failure, and a per-call limit does not catch it.
